posts.zh:
dsh-prompt-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eee84d2e2d6abe2d6d0f.html
posts.en:
dsh-prompt-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eee84d2e2d6abe2d6d0f.html
